question_text: A 15-year-old girl is recruited by a neighbor to work as a domestic helper in another city. The neighbor promises her family a monthly salary of ₱5,000, but upon arrival, the girl is forced to work 18 hours a day without pay and is not allowed to contact her family. Which law provides special protection to the girl in this situation?

options.text: RA 7610 (Special Protection of Children Against Abuse, Exploitation and Discrimination Act)
RA 9262 (Anti-Violence Against Women and Their Children Act)
